title: Elden Ring Somber Smithing Stone 9 Locations: Where to Find and Buy Them
description: Find Somber Smithing Stone 9 locations in Elden Ring, where to buy them infinitely, how to get one early, and which Bell Bearing unlocks the shop.
body:
Somber Smithing Stone [9] upgrades a special armament from +8 to +9 in Elden Ring, and each weapon only needs one. You can find individual stones well before the end of the game, including in Dragonbarrow, but the unlimited source comes from the Twin Maiden Husks.

Give the Twin Maiden Husks Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] and they will sell Somber Smithing Stone [9] for 25,000 runes each. The Bell Bearing is found late in Crumbling Farum Azula, in the small chapel one level below the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace.

If you only need one stone, you do not have to wait that long. Dragonbarrow has two useful pickups that can be reached much earlier than Crumbling Farum Azula.
author: Rouane Mounssif
imageAlt: A Tarnished stands beneath the glowing Erdtree in Elden Ring, framed by golden branches, ruined stone structures and the Lands Between below.
imageCredit: Neural Critic / Elden Ring gameplay screenshot.

contentBlocks.text:
The permanent source is the **Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold**. After you give them **Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5]**, their shop adds an unlimited supply of Somber Smithing Stone [9].

Each stone costs **25,000 runes**. Because special weapons only use one Somber stone per upgrade step, you need exactly one Somber Smithing Stone [9] for each weapon you want to take from +8 to +9.

The Bell Bearing's unlocked shop inventory also carries into New Game Plus, so once you have liberated this stock you do not need to unlock it again in the next journey.
contentBlocks.caption: Somber Smithing Stone [9] is the +9 upgrade material for special armaments that use the Somber upgrade path.
contentBlocks.heading: Where to buy Somber Smithing Stone 9
contentBlocks.imageAlt: The Elden Ring blacksmith menu shows a weapon upgrade and the Smithing Stone materials required to strengthen it.

contentBlocks.text:
**Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] is in Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace.** It is a late-game pickup rather than a boss reward.

From **Beside the Great Bridge**:

1. Turn around from the Site of Grace and take the elevator back down.
2. Descend the stairs and continue into the nearby chapel.
3. Look for the corpse beside the altar.
4. Loot **Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5]**.
5. Return to Roundtable Hold and give it to the Twin Maiden Husks.

The Bell Bearing unlocks **Somber Smithing Stone [9]** for unlimited purchase. It does not unlock the final Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone needed for +10.
contentBlocks.heading: How to get Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5

contentBlocks.text:
You can get a Somber Smithing Stone [9] much earlier than the Bell Bearing if your goal is to push one special weapon to +9.

### Dragonbarrow West

A Somber Smithing Stone [9] can be looted from a corpse near the **base of the Divine Tower of Caelid**, east of the Dragonbarrow West Site of Grace. The corpse is surrounded by a circle of chairs.

### West of Farum Greatbridge

Another early option is a **Teardrop Scarab west of the Farum Greatbridge Site of Grace** in Dragonbarrow. Defeat the scarab and it drops a Somber Smithing Stone [9].

Dragonbarrow is dangerous at low levels, but neither pickup requires you to reach the late-game Crumbling Farum Azula route. That makes these two locations useful if you already have a favorite Somber weapon and want a very early +9 upgrade.
contentBlocks.heading: How to get Somber Smithing Stone 9 early

contentBlocks.text:
If you miss the Dragonbarrow stones or need more for several weapons, later regions contain many additional pickups.

### Lake of Rot

A Somber Smithing Stone [9] sits on a corpse on the raised platform where a lesser Alabaster Lord appears.

### Mountaintops of the Giants

One can be found on a corpse sitting on a chair on the bridge south of **Stargazer Ruins**.

### Consecrated Snowfield

The region contains several Somber Smithing Stone [9] pickups, including one on the rock formation north of the Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace and another east of the Apostate Derelict.

### Yelough Anix Tunnel

A Somber Smithing Stone [9] is available inside **Yelough Anix Tunnel**, in the room where an Onyx Lord appears.

### Crumbling Farum Azula

Farum Azula contains several Somber Smithing Stone [9] pickups around the Dragon Temple and surrounding ruins, making it one of the richest base-game areas for this material.

Miquella's Haligtree and Elphael also contain additional stones if you are progressing through the Haligtree route.
contentBlocks.heading: Other reliable Somber Smithing Stone 9 locations

contentBlocks.text:
Shadow of the Erdtree adds more Somber Smithing Stone [9] pickups, so players already exploring the Realm of Shadow have additional options.

Notable sources include the Troll Knight at **Castle Ensis**, the **Specimen Storehouse** in Shadow Keep, the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, and **Enir-Ilim**.

You do not need the DLC to obtain or buy Somber Smithing Stone [9]. The base game's Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] still unlocks the unlimited Roundtable Hold supply.
contentBlocks.heading: Somber Smithing Stone 9 in Shadow of the Erdtree

contentBlocks.text:
Somber Smithing Stone [9] takes a **special armament from +8 to +9**. Unlike regular Smithing Stones, the Somber upgrade path uses only one stone at each tier.

The final +9 to +10 upgrade requires a **Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone**, which is a separate, limited material and cannot be bought through Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5].

If your weapon uses the standard +25 upgrade path instead, see Neural Critic's [Elden Ring Smithing Stone 8 locations guide](/stories/elden-ring-smithing-stone-8-locations/). For the broader upgrade priorities around a first playthrough, our [Elden Ring early-game progression guide](/stories/elden-ring-early-progression-what-to-upgrade-first/) covers what is worth strengthening first.
contentBlocks.heading: What does Somber Smithing Stone 9 upgrade?

quickRead: Somber Smithing Stone [9] upgrades a special armament from +8 to +9, and each weapon only needs one.
Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] is found near the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace in Crumbling Farum Azula and unlocks unlimited Somber Smithing Stone [9] purchases.
You can get Somber Smithing Stone [9] earlier in Dragonbarrow from a corpse near the Divine Tower of Caelid or a Teardrop Scarab west of Farum Greatbridge.
conclusion:
If you only need one Somber Smithing Stone [9], the Dragonbarrow pickups are the fastest way to avoid waiting for late-game progression. If you plan to upgrade several special weapons, collect Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] in Crumbling Farum Azula and buy an unlimited supply from the Twin Maiden Husks for 25,000 runes each.

After +9, save a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone for the special weapon you actually want to take to +10.
